summary: Saratoga Investment Corp. (BDC, NYSE: SAR) filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated September 23, 2026 with Lucid Capital Markets as representative of several underwriters for an additional $23,092,350 aggregate principal amount of its 8.00% Notes due 2031 (NYSE: SAX), inclusive of the overallotment option. The notes are a reopen of the existing series issued August 26, 2026 ($85.0M) and September 2, 2026 ($12.75M), governed by the May 2013 base indenture and Eighteenth Supplemental Indenture, same CUSIP, fungible and pari passu. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation.
